bullets.text: Developed REST API endpoints with clear validation, error handling, and maintainable service-layer logic for business workflows.
Implemented backend features using SQL-backed persistence, automated tests, Git review workflows, and CI/CD release practices.
Improved service reliability by troubleshooting production issues, documenting fixes, and adding observability for critical paths.
Collaborated with frontend, QA, and product partners to refine requirements and deliver secure, scalable application behavior.
